title: Kairo Z3 Pro 5G (Glacier Silver, 8GB RAM, 256GB Storage)

sections.description:
About this item
Ultra-smooth 6.5 inch AMOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate and 1500 nits peak brightness.
67W TurboCharge: 0 to 100% in about 42 minutes (67W charger included).
50 MP main camera with optical image stabilization (OIS) for sharp photos and steady videos, plus an 8 MP ultra-wide camera.
32 MP front camera for detailed selfies.
Kairo K9 octa-core processor (4nm) with 8GB RAM and 256GB UFS 3.1 storage.
Slim 7.6 mm design weighing just 178 g, with IP54 splash and dust resistance.
KairoOS 4 based on Android 15, with 3 years of OS updates and 4 years of security updates.

reviews: 5.0 out of 5 stars | Charging is insanely fast. 67W charging takes it from 15% to full in about 40 minutes. I never worry about battery because a quick top-up is enough.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Battery life is just average. The 4500 mAh battery lasts a day with moderate use, but heavy users will need to charge in the evening. Fast charging makes up for it.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Best display in this price. 144Hz AMOLED is extremely smooth and very bright outdoors. Watching videos in sunlight is not a problem at all.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Camera with OIS is great. Night photos are much better than my previous phone thanks to OIS. Videos are stable even while walking.
2.0 out of 5 stars | Storage is not expandable. There is no microSD slot, so 256GB is all you get. Should be enough for most, but I wanted to add a card.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Light and slim. At 178 grams it is very comfortable to hold and fits easily in the pocket. Feels premium with the glass back.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Great for gaming. BGMI runs at high settings with 90fps and the phone stays only slightly warm. Performance is excellent for the price.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Glass back is slippery. The phone slides off tables and sofas easily. There is no case in the box, so buy one immediately.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Clean software. KairoOS has very few preinstalled apps and no ads. Three years of updates is a big plus in this segment.
1.0 out of 5 stars | Battery drains fast while gaming. One hour of gaming drops the battery by almost 20%. Charging is quick, but I expected better battery life.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Selfies look sharp. The 32MP front camera takes detailed selfies and video calls look clear. Skin tones are natural.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Survived the rain. Got caught in heavy Mumbai rain with the phone in my shirt pocket and it works perfectly. The IP54 rating helps.
3.0 out of 5 stars | A bit expensive. It costs about 3,000 more than similar phones. You pay for the fast charging, display and camera. Worth it only if you care about those.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Stereo speakers sound good. Balanced and loud, better than most phones in this range. Dolby-style audio settings work well.
